item.title: Who is White Speed? Viral stream sniper stuns Jasontheween during 7 Days Stranded island livestream
item.description: White Speed went viral after suddenly appearing on Jasontheween’s “7 Days Stranded” island livestream. The surprise moment shocked viewers and added to his growing online fame. Known for following IShowSpeed during live streams, including the 2025 to 2026 Africa tour, White Speed continues to grab attention with unexpected appearances that leave streamers stunned.

item.title: Jasontheween’s dating history: Inside the Twitch star’s rumored ex-girlfriends and past relationships
item.description: Jason “Jasontheween” built much of his Twitch fame not only through gaming but also through public relationships. From Yujin to Shizuku to Sakura Shymko, each connection played out in front of thousands of viewers. While some relationships were confirmed and others were not, Jason has openly shared how hard dating can be when everything happens live online.

item.title: Aunties to play matchmakers for single Americans: Singapore’s new tourism campaign replaces dating apps
item.description: Singapore invites single Americans to a unique dating experience. Forget apps, 'aunties' will select your match. Two lucky winners get a free trip to Singapore for a blind date. The package includes flights, accommodation, and an 'auntie-approved' itinerary. This campaign blends tourism with human connection, showcasing Singapore's culture and food. Applications close March 13, 2026.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Does Shia LaBeouf have a twin sister? Viral TikToker Anya Wick makes shocking birth claim as arrest news surfaces
item.description: A viral TikTok video claimed Anya Wick is Shia LaBeouf’s twin sister, but facts show he is an only child born June 11, 1986. There is no record of a twin. Meanwhile, the New Orleans Police Department confirmed his February 17, 2026 arrest for simple battery, according to ABC News. The twin claim remains unverified.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Rhode Island hockey arena shooting suspect Robert Dorgan wore miniskirts and heels to work, colleagues say
item.description: A father of six, Robert Dorgan, employed at General Dynamics Bath Iron Works, committed a shocking act of violence. He fatally shot his son Aidan and ex-wife Rhonda at a Rhode Island hockey game. Dorgan also injured his former in-laws at the same event. Authorities are investigating the motive behind this tragic incident. The events unfolded on Monday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Les Wexner faces closed-door deposition over Epstein ties as new DOJ files emerge
item.description: Billionaire Les Wexner faced a congressional deposition over his past ties to Jeffrey Epstein. New documents reveal Epstein managed Wexner's finances, with Wexner claiming Epstein stole millions. Despite Wexner's claims of severing ties in 2007, emails show contact in 2008. Wexner denies knowledge of Epstein's crimes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Rubio in secret talks with Cuba’s Raul Guillermo Rodriguez, grandson of Castro
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio engaged in secret discussions with Raul Guillermo Rodriguez Castro, grandson of Cuba's leader, bypassing official channels. These talks focused on Cuba's future amid unprecedented US pressure, with the administration viewing the younger Castro as a key figure for potential rapprochement.

item.description: Larry Wheels addressed the livestream incident involving DeenTheGreat, saying online clips did not show the full context. item.title: India-AI Impact Summit 2026: Sweden’s Deputy PM Ebba Busch backs India’s AI leadership, hails EU deal; who is she?
item.description: Sweden’s Deputy Prime Minister Ebba Busch attended the India-AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi, backing India’s growing role in global AI governance and innovation. She underscored deepening India-Sweden ties across technology, energy and trade, welcomed the EU-India free trade agreement as a strategic milestone, and signalled stronger long-term collaboration in AI, industry and investment.

item.title: Two-month old baby treated for bronchitis deported after three weeks in ICE custody: Texas Congressman Castro
item.description: A two-month-old baby boy, Juan Nicolas, was hospitalized with bronchitis and became unresponsive in ICE custody. He was later deported to Mexico with his family. Congressman Joaquin Castro condemned the action. Senator Cornyn stated that most horror stories are made up by the media. Another child, Maria Isabella, was released and celebrated her birthday. Conditions at Dilley are being monitored.

item.title: “He was my security guard”: Clavicular fuels controversy after Brianna Chickenfry questions his real age and past security job
item.description: Clavicular has come under scrutiny after Brianna Chickenfry questioned his age, claiming he worked as a bar security guard three years ago despite reportedly being only 20 now. The timeline sparked speculation online about whether he misrepresented his age or used a fake ID. The viral debate has raised broader questions about hiring rules and verification practices.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: Saudi Arabia Founding Day 2026: Date, history, significance and celebration of 300 years of statehood
item.description: Saudi Arabia commemorates Founding Day on February 22, honouring the 1727 establishment of the first Saudi state by Muhammad bin Saud. This paid public holiday celebrates deep historical roots, cultural heritage and national pride, distinct from National Day's focus on modern unification. Celebrations foster unity and connect citizens to their enduring legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Emirates CFO Michael Doersam announces retirement, who’s next in line?
item.description: Emirates Group's Chief Financial and Group Services Officer, Michael Doersam, will step down at the end of June 2026 for family reasons after nearly two decades. His departure marks the end of a significant era for the Dubai-based aviation giant.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Lake Tahoe avalanche: Skiers ignored warnings? 10 missing after Castle Peak slide amidst severe winter storm in US
item.description: A massive avalanche near Lake Tahoe in US, on February 17, 2026, buried 10 backcountry skiers amid a severe winter storm. Six survivors were found alive but rescue efforts are hampered by whiteout conditions and high winds. This incident highlights a deadly winter season and the extreme risks of backcountry travel.
